item.title: How a Bridge Loan and a Bank Statement Loan Got My Clients Into Their Dream Home Before They Sold
item.description: My clients owned a business, had a townhouse to sell, and found their dream home in the middle of the process. Here's how a bank statement loan and a bridge loan got them the keys without a rushed sale.
